chapter_title: 第98章 李珞你們人呢?

segments.title: 第98章 李珞你們人呢?
segments.content:
Chapter 98: Li Luo, Where Are You Guys?

During the National Day holiday, First Affiliated High School was very quiet.

After entering the school through the guardhouse, Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng had the rare sight of an empty Houde Road and academic building.

"It feels like we're exploring a mystery," Xu Youyu said enthusiastically, looking around. "Are you guys going straight to play basketball?"

"What else?" Li Luo held a basketball, dribbling it a few times now and then before passing it to Zhao Rongjun.

With girls nearby, Zhao Rongjun became a little stiff. After catching the ball, he just held it dazedly, not saying a word.

"Have you guys played basketball before?" Li Luo turned his head and asked.

"Nope." Xu Youyu shook her head, then looked at Yan Zhusheng. "What about you? Zhusheng, have you played before?"

"A little." Yan Zhusheng gestured with her fingers. "I play badminton more."

The four of them walked and talked, and soon they were near the outdoor basketball court.

Xu Youyu looked over and was surprised to find other people playing. "It's the National Day holiday, and there are still people who came to school to play basketball like us?"

Li Luo followed her gaze, walked to the edge of the court, and broke into a smile. "Well, look who it is."

With that, he trotted forward, happened to catch the ball as it bounced off the rim, then made a beautiful three-step layup, landing in front of the others. "Teacher Kong, you guys didn't go home for the National Day holiday?"

"Yo." When Kong Junxiang saw Li Luo, he raised his eyebrows and smiled. "We already went home, we just came back early."

"What's the point of going home?" Teacher Zhao from Class Three tutted twice. "Just to get rushed into marriage?"

"Say less in front of the students." Teacher Sun from Class One adjusted his glasses and looked at Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun who had followed behind him. "You two came to play too? Just in time for a 3v3."

Just as Li Luo was about to agree, Teacher Cao from Year Two, Class One, had already exclaimed in surprise. Seeing his own prized student, Xu Youyu, walking over slowly, he asked with confusion, "Why did you come to school?"

"Teacher Cao?" Xu Youyu was also a little surprised. "You play basketball? I've never seen you play before."

"Yan Zhusheng is here too," Kong Junxiang said, smiling as he saw Yan Zhusheng beside Xu Youyu. "What's this lineup of yours?"

"Oh, I'm renting a room at his place now," Xu Youyu said, pointing at Li Luo. "Yan Zhusheng happened to come over to his house to hang out, and since we were all free, we came out together to watch them play."

"I remember..." Kong Junxiang's gaze shifted to Teacher Sun from Class One. "Your class's Ying Chanxi is also living with Li Luo, right?"

"The top students of Year One and Year Two are both in my hands." Li Luo chuckled. "You all better go easy on me later."

"I think you're asking for a beating, kid," Teacher Sun tutted, looking at Teacher Cao beside him. "The two of us on a team, plus Xiao Zhao over there. The three of you can be a team, how about it?"

"Sounds like you're quite fired up," Teacher Zhao from Class Three watched the fun from the side with a grin. "Then let's do it like that."

"Go, Teacher Cao!" Xu Youyu, who enjoyed stoking the flames, cheerfully rooted for her own class teacher.

Yan Zhusheng looked at Xu Youyu, then at Kong Junxiang, and gave a symbolic wave of her hand. "Go, Teacher Kong."

"Your cheering has zero enthusiasm," Li Luo said, shaking his head. "We can't be outdone by the other side. Follow my lead, GO, TEACHER KONG!!!"

Kong Junxiang was startled by his sudden loud shout and smacked him on the head in annoyance. "You kid, be a bit more composed. Don't be a bad influence on Yan Zhusheng."

"Go, Teacher Kong." It was a little louder than before, but that was about it. Yan Zhusheng blinked, a completely different person from when she sang with her clear voice.

"Alright, alright, it's the thought that counts." Kong Junxiang waved his hand, cradled the basketball, and walked to the three-point line. "We're starting."

As soon as he finished speaking, the ball in Kong Junxiang's hands was quickly passed to Li Luo.

The offense began.

Neither Xu Youyu nor Yan Zhusheng knew much about the rules of basketball; they only knew that scoring a basket earned points.

Among the four teachers, aside from the slightly younger Kong Junxiang who was still in good shape, the other three all had a bit of a paunch.

The avengers' alliance formed by Teacher Sun and Teacher Cao was a combination of a beer belly and a balding head.

But they were, after all, people who often played together on weekends. Although they were a bit fat, they were still quite agile as they maneuvered around the court.

The two sides were locked in a fierce battle. Xu Youyu cheered and applauded from the sidelines, while Yan Zhusheng clapped her hands softly, silently rooting for Li Luo's team.

With the goal of defeating their opponents, this showdown was much more intense than the one before the school year started.

In just about an hour, both sides were out of breath.

Teacher Zhao propped his hands on his knees and sat down on the bench, panting heavily. "No more, no more. I have things to do this afternoon."

Teacher Sun and Teacher Cao were not in much better shape, gasping for air with their hands on their hips, each one huffing and puffing like a fan.

"Let's call it a day," Kong Junxiang said to Li Luo, wiping the sweat from his forehead. "We have to go write questions for your midterm exams later."

"Okay." Li Luo nodded, then said with a smile, "I can help you guys with that."

"In your dreams," Kong Junxiang glanced at him and said with a laugh. "You young men are full of energy, go on and play. We'll be leaving now."

"Bye-bye, Teacher Cao," Xu Youyu said goodbye to her class teacher.

Teacher Cao shook his head with a resigned smile, only asking, "Your parents know that you're renting a room at Li Luo's place, right?"

"They know," Xu Youyu blinked. "Actually, his family wasn't the landlord before. But over the summer, Li Luo's family bought the apartment, so the landlord changed. My mom met his mom once."

"Oh, that's fine then." After confirming the situation, Teacher Cao nodded in relief, waved his hand, and left.

But Li Luo, who overheard their conversation, immediately asked curiously, "My mom has met your mom?"

"Yes," Xu Youyu said as if it were obvious. "The rental contract had to be re-signed, so of course my mom had to come over."

"I see." Li Luo nodded in understanding. Just as he was about to ask something else, the phone in his pocket suddenly vibrated.

He took out his phone and saw it was a call from Ying Chanxi.

"Hello?"

"Li Luo, where are you guys? Why has everyone disappeared?" Ying Chanxi questioned from the other end of the line. "No one's in the living room, the bedrooms, or the piano room. Did you guys go out?"

"Oh, Zhao Rongjun and I came to school to play basketball," Li Luo said.

"What about senior and Zhusheng?"

"The two of them insisted on joining the fun, so they came to watch us play," Li Luo replied with a smile. "Teacher Sun from your class was here just now too. We played a game together, but the teachers have all left now."

"Oh, I see." Ying Chanxi's tone was calm. "Are you guys still playing? If you are, I'll bring Xinyan over to hang out."

"Sure," Li Luo nodded. "You two can come over. And buy a few drinks on the way."

"Okay, you wait," Ying Chanxi said and immediately hung up the phone.

(End of this chapter)
